options.content: **Como ler:** os mapas mostram o salão (Living Lab) **no fim do período escolhido no canto superior direito**. Para ver outro momento, por exemplo ontem às 15h, mude o fim do período. **Temperatura:** bolinhas = valor medido em cada HOBO; as cores entre elas são estimadas (interpolação) e somem longe dos sensores. A escala é fixa (20–30 °C) para que a mesma cor signifique sempre a mesma temperatura. **CO₂:** cada bancada recebe a cor do seu sensor. **Quadrados azuis** = ares-condicionados Daikin (preenchido = ligado).

panels.description: Interpolação thin-plate spline entre os 20 HOBO (15 MX1101 + 5 MX1102). Valores fora da faixa medida não são inventados.

const traceAC = {type:'scatter', mode:'markers+text', hoverinfo:'text',
  x: Object.values(AC).map(p => p[0]), y: Object.values(AC).map(p => p[1]),
  text: Object.keys(AC).map(u => u.replace('_','-')), textposition:'bottom center', textfont:{color:'#8AB8FF', size:10},
  hovertext: Object.keys(AC).map(u => 'Daikin ' + u.replace('_','-') + ': ' + (acs[u] === 1 ? 'ligado' : acs[u] === 0 ? 'desligado' : 'sem dado')),
  marker:{symbol:'square-open', size:16, color: Object.keys(AC).map(u => acs[u] === 1 ? '#5794F2' : '#8AB8FF'), line:{width: 2.5}}};
const baseLayout = (titulo) => ({
  margin:{l:0, r:0, t:30, b:0}, paper_bgcolor:'rgba(0,0,0,0)', plot_bgcolor:'rgba(0,0,0,0)', showlegend:false,
  title:{text: titulo, font:{size:13, color:'#ccccdc'}, x:0.01},
  xaxis:{type:'linear', autorange:false, range:[VX, VX + VW], visible:false, fixedrange:true, constrain:'domain'},
  yaxis:{type:'linear', autorange:false, range:[VY + VH, VY], visible:false, scaleanchor:'x', scaleratio:1, fixedrange:true, constrain:'domain'},
  images:[{source: FUNDO, xref:'x', yref:'y', x:VX, y:VY, sizex:VW, sizey:VH, sizing:'stretch', layer:'below', opacity:1}],
  hoverlabel:{bgcolor:'#22252b'}
});

// Temperatura: interpolação thin-plate spline entre os 20 HOBO, só dentro do salão
const {out: temps, quando} = tabela('TEMP', 'serie');
const pts = [], vals = [], nomes = [];
for (const [s, v] of Object.entries(temps)) if (POS[s] && v != null) { pts.push([POS[s][0] / 1000, POS[s][1] / 1000]); vals.push(v); nomes.push(s); }
const n = pts.length;
if (n < 4) return {data: [traceAC], layout: Object.assign(baseLayout('Temperatura: sem dados de HOBO neste horário'), {})};
const U = r => r > 0 ? r * r * Math.log(r) : 0;
const N = n + 3, A = [], b = [];
for (let i = 0; i < N; i++) { A.push(new Array(N).fill(0)); b.push(i < n ? vals[i] : 0); }
for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
  for (let j = 0; j < n; j++) A[i][j] = U(Math.hypot(pts[i][0] - pts[j][0], pts[i][1] - pts[j][1])) + (i === j ? 0.002 : 0);
  A[i][n] = A[n][i] = 1; A[i][n + 1] = A[n + 1][i] = pts[i][0]; A[i][n + 2] = A[n + 2][i] = pts[i][1];
}
for (let c = 0; c < N; c++) { let p = c; for (let r = c + 1; r < N; r++) if (Math.abs(A[r][c]) > Math.abs(A[p][c])) p = r;
  [A[c], A[p]] = [A[p], A[c]]; [b[c], b[p]] = [b[p], b[c]];
  for (let r = 0; r < N; r++) if (r !== c) { const f = A[r][c] / A[c][c]; for (let k = c; k < N; k++) A[r][k] -= f * A[c][k]; b[r] -= f * b[c]; } }
const w = b.map((v, i) => v / A[i][i]);
const vmin = Math.min(...vals), vmax = Math.max(...vals);
const xs = [], ys = [], z = [];
for (let i = 0; i <= 89; i++) xs.push(VX + VW * i / 89);
for (let j = 0; j <= 107; j++) ys.push(VY + VH * j / 107);
for (const y of ys) { const row = []; for (const x of xs) {
  if (!dentro(x, y)) { row.push(null); continue; }
  const X = x / 1000, Y = y / 1000; let dmin = 1e9, s = w[n] + w[n + 1] * X + w[n + 2] * Y;
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) { const d = Math.hypot(X - pts[i][0], Y - pts[i][1]); s += w[i] * U(d); dmin = Math.min(dmin, d); }
  row.push(dmin > 0.24 ? null : Math.max(vmin, Math.min(vmax, s))); } z.push(row); }
const ZMIN = 20, ZMAX = 30;
const heat = {type:'heatmap', x: xs, y: ys, z, zmin: ZMIN, zmax: ZMAX, zsmooth:'best', opacity:0.6, hoverinfo:'skip',
  colorscale:[[0,'#313695'],[0.2,'#4575b4'],[0.35,'#74add1'],[0.5,'#ffffbf'],[0.65,'#fdae61'],[0.8,'#f46d43'],[1,'#a50026']],
  colorbar:{title:{text:'°C', font:{color:'#ccccdc'}}, tickfont:{color:'#ccccdc'}, thickness:12, len:0.6}};
const sens = {type:'scatter', mode:'markers+text', x: nomes.map(s => POS[s][0]), y: nomes.map(s => POS[s][1]),
  text: vals.map(v => v.toFixed(1)), textposition:'top right', textfont:{color:'#ffffff', size:11},
  marker:{size:8, color:'#ffffff', line:{color:'#111217', width:1}},
  hovertemplate: nomes.map((s, i) => 'HOBO ' + s + '<br>' + vals[i].toFixed(2) + ' °C<extra></extra>')};
const media = vals.reduce((a, v) => a + v, 0) / n;
return {data: [heat, traceAC, sens],
  layout: baseLayout('Temperatura · ' + fmtHora(quando) + ' · média ' + media.toFixed(1) + ' °C · variação ' + (vmax - vmin).toFixed(1) + ' °C'),
  config: {displayModeBar: false, responsive: true}};
